statement: The program reads text.txt from the current directory. The file contains words separated by spaces and newlines and uses only lowercase ASCII letters a-z. The program prints up to three lines, one per distinct word, for the three most frequent words. Each line is WORD, one space, COUNT. Lines are ordered by COUNT descending; words with the same count are ordered alphabetically ascending. If there are fewer than three distinct words, it prints fewer lines; if the file has no words, it prints nothing.
